summary: Iteration-8 e2e regression: 24/24 pytest cases PASS (image upload validation, edit-preserve, media audit, blog upgrade, related apps, sitemap/regression). Frontend E2E confirms all requested data-testids exist and work: /admin/blog exposes every documented input (blog-title, blog-slug, blog-author, blog-category, blog-tags, blog-cover-upload, blog-excerpt, blog-content, blog-seo-title, blog-meta-description, blog-keywords, blog-focus-keyword, blog-og-image, blog-noindex, blog-scheduled-at, blog-published, save-blog-btn) plus filter chips (blog-filter-all/published/scheduled/draft). /admin/seo-dashboard shows media-audit-card + media-audit-refresh (after Card testid fix). /admin/seo exposes seo-ga4/seo-gsc/seo-bing. Analytics injection verified live: setting ga4_id='G-TESTXX' emits <script src='https://www.googletagmanager.com/gtag/js?id=G-TESTXX'>, gsc='abc123' emits <meta name='google-site-verification' content='abc123'>, and clearing both removes the tags. Related apps API returns 6 different apps with ≥3 same-category matches; UI shows data-testid=detail-related with 4 clickable data-testid=related-<id> cards on /rumble-rummy. Homepage: 55 apps total (52 in main list + 3 featured carousel = spec), all SEO tags exactly single (no duplicates), sitemap has 56 <loc> entries.

minor.issue: Takes ~6-8s on 55 apps because it runs sequential object-storage HEAD-equivalents per image. Frontend SEO Dashboard blocks the whole initial render on this call (Promise.all with overview + apps + audit). Consider (a) parallelising checks with asyncio.gather, or (b) rendering the dashboard body first and lazy-loading the media-audit card independently — SeoDashboardPage.load() currently shows a full-page spinner until audit finishes.

issues: No JSON-LD is emitted on the homepage (carried over from iteration_7). SEOHead only pushes JSON-LD when app/breadcrumbs/faqItems props are provided; Store.jsx passes none. Adding a WebSite + Organization schema would enrich Google results.
Initial load blocks for ~6-8s on the media-audit endpoint before rendering ANY content — user sees only a spinner. Split loading state (overview+apps first, audit second).

action_items: OPTIONAL/MINOR: Parallelise /api/admin/media/audit existence checks with asyncio.gather (currently sequential await inside two loops → ~55 round-trips ≈ 6-8s). Simple fix: build a list of (kind, id, field, filename) tuples first, then `await asyncio.gather(*[_check_upload_exists(f) for _,_,_,f in items])`.

OPTIONAL: In SeoDashboardPage.jsx, split the initial Promise.all so overview+apps render immediately and the media-audit card fills in asynchronously — currently the entire page blocks until audit resolves.
OPTIONAL: Consider emitting a default WebSite/Organization JSON-LD from SEOHead when no app/breadcrumbs/faqItems are provided (Store.jsx does not supply any → homepage has 0 JSON-LD).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py PUT /admin/apps/{id} was throwing 500 (Firestore: 'Cannot update with an empty document') whenever the caller sent ONLY image-clear fields (icon_url='', apk_url='', og_image='', screenshots=[]) — the preserve-images logic stripped all four keys leaving updates={}. This directly violates the requirement 'edit preserves images and must not crash the app'. Fixed in this iteration by returning the existing doc when the sanitised update dict is empty.

adminUI.jsx <Card> component silently DROPPED any HTML attribute other than className (no {...rest} spread). This caused SeoDashboardPage's data-testid='media-audit-card' to never reach the DOM — automated tests couldn't locate the card. Fixed by adding {...rest} spread on <Card>. Same fix indirectly enables any future data-testid or aria-* on Card without needing another patch.
Media audit is O(N) sequential storage HEAD calls — will scale poorly beyond 500 apps. Wrap with asyncio.gather.

server.py has grown to 1667 lines mixing many domains (auth, apps, SEO, blog, reviews, winners, media, settings). Recommend splitting into routers/ for maintainability (previous iteration's comment still stands).
SEOHead.cleanupDuplicates still runs 5 defensive setTimeouts on every render — a scoped MutationObserver would be cheaper (carried over from iter7).
/api/admin/media (Media Library) walks local UPLOAD_DIR only; Emergent Object Storage uploads won't appear in the library UI (carried over).

Two real bugs were found & fixed IN THIS TESTING RUN: (1) PUT /admin/apps/{id} 500-crash on empty-image update — fixed with empty-updates guard in server.py line ~509. (2) <Card> in adminUI.jsx dropped data-testid — fixed with {...rest}. Both fixes are minor & safe. Analytics injection (GA4 + GSC + Bing) verified end-to-end. Related apps working, media audit clean (0 broken / 55 checked). Homepage 55 = 52 in list + 3 in featured carousel (expected). Sitemap: 56 <loc>, 55 <image:image>. Legacy image /api/uploads/00cc5a9062f84ce5aacbf51df61cac9e.jpg still 200. Large PNG → auto-WebP conversion confirmed (server returns content_type=image/webp, size < original). Unpublished hidden. Blog-meta returns {categories, tags}. Firebase Auth still blocked at user's project level; JWT branch works. Emergent Object Storage persistent — expected & correct.
rca of the issue: BUG-1 (edit-500): server.py line 508-511 strips icon_url/apk_url/og_image/screenshots from `updates` when they arrive empty (to preserve existing images). If the admin UI sent ONLY these four fields (which the AppsManager cover-image edit dialog does when the user hasn't touched anything), `updates` becomes {} and fbs.update_app() forwards it to Firestore's SetDocument which raises 'Cannot update with an empty document.' → uncaught → 500. Fix: added `if not updates: return await fbs.get_app(app_id) or 404` before the Firestore call. Verified with new pytest case test_empty_icon_url_does_not_wipe. BUG-2 (missing testid): <Card> component in adminUI.jsx destructured only {children,className} and dropped every other prop. Fixed with {...rest} spread on the underlying <div>. Verified: [data-testid='media-audit-card'] now queryable.
